description.en: The maximum number of entries per page.
A pagination token. It can be used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results.
The ID of the desired-state configuration.
The tags to be added to the configuration.

description.en: The name of the template. The name must be 1 to 200 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, hyphens (-), and underscores (\_).

description.zh: 版本号，如不填默认为最新的版本号。
description.en: The version number of the template. If you do not specify this parameter, the latest version of the template is used.
